event_name: SAUDI ARABIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 March 2022 In the interests of the safety of all participants in the Event, the Stewards have modified the Official Programme for Friday, 25th March 2022, at the request of the Organiser, by delaying the Second Practice Session by 15 minutes to start therefore at 20:15 Saudi Arabian time in accordance with Article 11.9.3.o of the International Sporting Code.
title: Stewards Change To Official Programme
